findings.reason: All six dimensions repeat one identical move paragraph plus a generic definition sentence ('This score reflects...'). The contract requires each dimension to explain its own actual source-specific strength/limitation, and distinguish consequences rather than repeating a flaw six times. Write complete dimension-specific explanations grounded in recoverable source. No controller-selected ratings; independently apply the pinned rubric.

Current six-dimension rationales include mixed handoff, caption uncertainty, garbled names or mixed wording as limiting context without separating their impact on participant ratings. In particular 'garbled names ... limit verification' and 'amid caption uncertainty' risk scoring transcription defects. Source restrictions prohibit that. Keep acquisition confidence separate; grade only recoverable argument. Explicitly account for whether those defects influenced the unsaved ratings.
